question: Can the selected ordinary successor-success predictor retain useful forecasting performance at a smaller probe budget, after selecting the budget and direct-read rival entirely inside each training fold?
source: All 512 previously exposed generation-14 records, eight acquisition blocks, and the already exposed balanced 32-record two-repeat panel. No new dynamics or future labels.
candidate: Unrestricted ridge logistic regression on the same eleven TT008 boundary features and q_rewrite(N), the success fraction of the first N writer-then-successor-evaluation probes. Fixed ridge 0.01; same solver and training-only standardization as the prior ordinary rewritten_count comparator.
endpoint: Generation-32 fresh-recipient native task success after eighteen original-writer rebuilds from generation 14. Uninterrupted success is a separate endpoint and is not predicted by this formula.

writer.kind: native exact original full rewrite from the final body

native_contract.injury: Twenty-four distinct uniformly sampled non-port cells per read; all three 2x2 ports protected. Writer and evaluation injuries are independent. Evaluation branches share the exact injury.
native_contract.success: All four task-aligned cue/port means over the last 32 observations must be strictly greater than 0.25.
native_contract.protected_retained_copy: The unchanged packet is a protected diagnostic copy. Its storage is explicit; this is not a demonstration of a free copying policy or autonomous record protection.

probe_selection: First N probes; development indices 0..N-1, repeat offsets 0 and 128. No choice of prefix, regime or record using the new results.

models.omitted_block_sets: empty, every singleton and every unordered pair of eight blocks: 37 training sets times 16 fixed specifications; reuse identical training sets without refitting.

observation_costs.rewrite: 2N native reads: N original reads that write successors and N fresh successor evaluations.
observation_costs.direct_pooled: 2N native reads of unchanged P: N writer-stage original reads plus N retained evaluations.
observation_costs.retained: N native reads of unchanged P in evaluation environments.
observation_costs.tt008: No additional native read; retains body response, history, unsigned access and signed T64 transfer among all eleven boundary features.

candidate_budget_selection.outer_split: Leave one entire acquisition block (64 related records) out.
candidate_budget_selection.inner_split: Seven leave-one-block-out folds within the other seven blocks; fitting and scaling exclude both outer and inner blocks.
candidate_budget_selection.score_rule: Choose the smallest N whose inner equal-block Brier is at most 0.001 worse than rewrite128 and whose inner forecast repeat p90 is <=0.10 in each current-expression stratum and each regime.
candidate_budget_selection.precision_rule: Use only repeat records from the seven outer-training blocks. Each repeat is forecast by the model excluding its own block and the outer block, at that N. No outer repeat record enters selection.
candidate_budget_selection.allowance_rationale: An explicit operational compression tolerance equal to half the inherited 0.002 practical Brier benefit. This is a development budget-screening choice, not a biological constant or evidence of noninferiority.
candidate_budget_selection.none_qualifies: Record selection failure. Use rewrite128 only to retain diagnostic outer predictions; no advancement is possible. No changed threshold or alternate fit.
candidate_budget_selection.full_fit_choice: After outer evaluation, apply the same rule to eight-block out-of-fold curves and own-block-excluded repeats, then retain the already fitted all-512 model at the selected N. It never supplies held-out scores.

rival_selection: Inside each outer training fold, choose the lowest inner Brier among TT008 and all direct_pooled/retained grid models whose native read budget is <=2 times the selected candidate N. Tie-break by model name. The rival may choose its own probe count within this cost allowance. It cannot use the outer labels or repeat records.
primary_comparisons: nested_selected_rewrite versus fixed rewrite128 for compression cost

evaluation.score: Equal-block Brier across eight outer held-out blocks. Descriptive two-sided 95% paired block t intervals. All fixed-budget curves also reported, with no retrospective selection from their outer scores.
evaluation.precision: Apply each outer fold selected model and budget to both repeats of its own omitted-block pilot records; report p90 separately in the two current-expression strata and both regimes.
evaluation.strata: Both current-expression strata and four histories, with conditional scores and additive contributions; no subgroup rescue.
evaluation.anchor: At N=128, singleton-fold tt008, rewrite, direct_pooled and retained predictions must match their archived counterparts within absolute 1e-8.
evaluation.decision_label: READY_TO_PRICE_FRESH_ORDINARY_PREDICTOR_COHORT only if every development screen passes; otherwise ORDINARY_LEAD_SCREEN_FAILED.
evaluation.planning: Use eight outer block differences; inherited plugin t/normal formula, n=64..256 step16. Margin .002 versus TT008, margin zero versus the equal-or-lower-cost direct-read rival. Report upper-SD sensitivity from the 95% normal-theory variance bound. Approximate planning, not a power guarantee.
evaluation.different_scope: The new screen concerns a useful ordinary predictor and an equal-cost rewrite-versus-direct-read contrast. The zero incremental margin for the cost-matched control is a directional mechanism screen, not the prior RDT-specific >.002 advantage requirement. It cannot overturn the failed paired reduction or establish RDT novelty.

candidate_test_box.properties: Eleven TT008 boundary features plus a fixed-budget probability of successful expression after one native rewrite.
candidate_test_box.outcome: Fresh-recipient task success after eighteen original-writer rebuilds from generation 14; terminal, not uninterrupted success.
candidate_test_box.held_out_change: Any subsequent prospective cohort must use new acquisition blocks and bind both matched and independent birth/ongoing cue-noise conditions. Independent-noise repeat precision alone does not establish shift calibration.
candidate_test_box.strongest_comparators: TT008 including signed transfer, and the strongest training-selected direct-read count comparator at equal or lower native-read budget. Preserve the failed paired predictor as historical context.
candidate_test_box.future_rejection: Before fresh outcomes, freeze chosen budgets, coefficients, cohort and computational budget. A prospective advantage would require paired one-sided 97.5% lower block limits above .002 versus TT008 and zero versus the direct-read rival; an upper limit at or below its margin rejects the respective advantage. Otherwise unresolved. No such prospective test starts automatically here.

exposure_limits: The rewrite family was selected after 21 models were compared on these same eight blocks.
Nested selection protects against new budget/rival leakage; it does not erase previous exposure or family selection.
The repeat panel is balanced and previously selected for precision, not a population sample.
Earlier failed cycle, recovery and paired reductions retain their verdicts.
No paired-continuation or TT018 status/outcomes are inspected.
